parole.testo: Inherited from Manichaean Middle Persian 𐫑𐫀𐫎𐫇𐫗 (xʾṯwn /⁠xātūn⁠/, “lady, a Sogdian female title”), from Sogdian 𐼶𐼴𐽂𐼰𐼷𐼻𐼳 (γwtʾynh /⁠xwatēn, xutēn⁠/, “queen”) (or perhaps directly borrowed from Sogdian), from Proto-Iranian *hwatā́wHniH, a feminine form of Proto-Iranian *hwatā́wHā.
